remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. Claudia O'Keeffe was one of the artist's four sisters. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Graphite sketch showing full body of a young girl (the artist's sister) in profile. The drawing is focused in the center of the paper surrounded by negative space. The girl is wearing a bow in her short hair and a knee length dress. She is wearing shoes which have been heavily shaded in. The leg in the foreground is slightly bent. Signed and dated, lower right hand corner.
title: Untitled (Claudia O'Keeffe)
